details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]`: seen once in the last 15 rocm10 nightlies. The test hung after 246 of 249 tests had passed. It passed Nov 18–22, and no commit in the window touches `debug_utils`.

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[MEDIUM]` a port collision that was already in the grafter multi-process test helpers. Two independently chosen ports can match. A worker then dies in `init_process_group`, and the parent waits forever in `p.join()` (`test_dumper.py:3396-3470`). details.label: In-flight fix
